episodeDesign.thesis: Job safety beliefs weaken when the scale, speed and breadth of AI-linked work change become visible.
episodeDesign.emotionalArc: Begin with unease, move through concrete evidence, confront confident excuses, then enter specific professions.
chapterArc: Beliefs: why each profession feels protected

castBible.extras: Slender faceless variants retain profession clothing and hair.

locationBible.workplaces: Grounded furniture, thin rails, windows and task-specific tools.

beat.scriptLine: কিন্তু মজার ব্যাপার হলো, যারা এআই সবচেয়ে কাছ থেকে দেখে, তারা কিন্তু এত রিল্যাক্সড না।
beat.visualIntent: কিন্তু মজার ব্যাপার হলো, যারা এআই সবচেয়ে কাছ থেকে দেখে, তারা কিন্তু এত রিল্যাক্সড না। | Cut into a separate AI lab: three researchers type asynchronously beneath task displays, contrasting their proximity with casual confidence.

continuity.cast: Guide identity and each profession variant remain stable.
continuity.place: AI lab retains grounded furniture and baseline.
continuity.props: Returning records, phones and tools retain silhouette and palette.

semanticAnalysis.negation: Preserve any quoted denial or not-alone relationship exactly.
semanticAnalysis.notes: Read with neighboring cues; do not turn belief into verified fact.

alternatives: Literal reenactment centered on AI workers.
Abstract evidence diagram for closest observers are less relaxed.
designDecision.composition: three asynchronous operators sit below dense task displays
designDecision.visibleChange: hands type at different phases while screens remain blue
designDecision.why: Proximity is expressed through active daily work with the system.

referenceUse: Borrow staging, silhouette density, material and motion mechanism from ref_009_ai_lab_survey.jpg.

copyLedger.explanation: Wording either quotes the cue or condenses its stated meaning without adding a claim.

animationPlan.motivation: Proximity is expressed through active daily work with the system.
animationPlan.anticipation: AI workers orient head and weight toward the acting object before contact.
animationPlan.contact: multiple workers operate systems simultaneously; hands and any held prop share the same rig socket.
animationPlan.weightShift: Standing actors shift over the supporting foot; seated actors remain anchored through hips and chair.
animationPlan.followThrough: The action settles with a readable hold before hold into next argument.
animationPlan.secondaryMotion: AI lab uses offset breathing, tool response or environmental motion without synchronized looping.
animationPlan.gaze: Head direction leads toward the active hand, evidence or conversation partner.
animationPlan.cameraMotivation: wide lab observation supports the narrated relationship rather than decorative drift.

review.start: Opening state establishes AI lab with readable subject hierarchy.
review.middle: Action peak checked: multiple workers operate systems simultaneously.
review.end: Final hold leaves the narrated relationship legible before hold into next argument.
issues: Checked hand contact, text collisions, floor contact and unsupported factual additions.
fixes: Aligned held props to wrists, corrected baselines and separated text bands where required.
